Part.name: Duplet side module
Part.description: Duplet - modular side module (game proxy) Resize X to add whole cells along the length (1 to 8, 125 mm each); the height is fixed at two rows (500 mm). 250 mm per row, 48 mm deep, slotted mounting lip on the top edge and a hinge strip. Each cell has a 10 mm formed front plate and two 12 mm Nozh layers with a 10 mm steel plate between them; both layers spend independently, front layer first. Plates: 2 | Layers: 2 Effective angles: 30-70° (best APFSDS) Kinetic (APFSDS) at 60°: 30% less pen. Chemical (HEAT) at 60°: 70% less pen. Tandem: no guaranteed protection Extra loss, reference L/D 30; all layers intact Mass and cost scale with paid cell area only, never depth
